HTML to Markdown Converter

Turn HTML into clean Markdown: headings, bold/italic, links, lists, code blocks, and blockquotes.

📖 How to use

  1. Paste HTML into the input box.
  2. Click Convert to Markdown.
  3. Copy the Markdown or download it as a .md file.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which HTML elements convert?

Headings, paragraphs, bold/italic/strikethrough, links, images, ordered/unordered/nested lists, inline code, fenced code blocks, blockquotes, line breaks, and horizontal rules.

Does it handle messy HTML?

HTML is parsed with the browser's own DOMParser, so malformed markup is handled gracefully.

What happens to divs and spans?

They are dropped; only their text content is kept. Scripts and styles are removed entirely.

Is my HTML sent anywhere?

Yes — everything runs locally in your browser.
